task: Apply approved customer-facing 24-test names, seven groups and descriptions to the frontend, with a local-only review deployment.
nonGoals: No scoring rules, weights, backend, authentication, usage safeguards, public deployment or merge changes.
Do not relabel or combine legacy v1/v2 outcomes as v3 results.
Do not change the separately developed rubric engine or unrelated user files.

outcomes.description: All 24 approved question titles/descriptions appear in seven named groups with Structural or Data labels for rubric v3. Legacy reports retain correct version-specific checks.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen copy expectations and report rendering regressions.

outcomes.description: V3 presentation consumes returned component results without calculating new scores and fails safely on invalid/unsupported reports.
outcomes.evidence: Compatibility regressions for measured, unresolved, excluded and malformed data.

outcomes.description: A clearly marked local fixture preview shows the new copy behind the existing password UI, without production audit calls.
outcomes.evidence: Local browser review, mobile layout and authentication checks.

process.description: Commit plan before implementation; use Terra implementation and independent review; record real evaluation and limitations.
process.evidence: Git history, source-bound evaluation, review and handoff.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse report layout; isolate presentation changes and avoid dependencies or unrelated refactors.

exitTest.reason: Frontend copy/group display and local visual review do not alter agent portability, memory, resumability, or handoff mechanisms.
